    Lines in the universal cover #

    A line of the cover (BO13b, §1: a full convex subcategory given by a quiver of type A without relations) is recorded by its points pt 0, …, pt n and the orientations fwd i of the arrows joining pt i and pt (i + 1) (CLine, and WLine without convexity). Directed runs of a line are bounded by the number of morphisms of P (run_le_fwd, run_le_bwd), so a long line has many sinks (exists_sinks). Two sinks with the same image in P whose outer incoming arrows have different labels form a good pair (GoodPair; BO23, proof of Theorem 7); a long enough line contains one (exists_goodPair).

    structure LargeIndecomposable.RayCat.WLine {P : Type} [CategoryTheory.Category.{0, 0} P] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms P] [IsRayCategory P] (x₀ : P) :
    Type

    A weak line of the universal cover: points pt 0, …, pt n joined by irreducible morphisms, the i-th one pointing to pt (i + 1) iff fwd i, with nonzero paths.

    • n : ℕ

      The number of arrows.

    • pt : ℕ → Cover x₀

      The points.

    • fwd : ℕ → Bool

      The orientations.

    • inj (a b : ℕ) : a ≤ self.n → b ≤ self.n → self.pt a = self.pt b → a = b
    • arrF (i : ℕ) : i < self.n → self.fwd i = true → ∃ (f : self.pt i ⟶ self.pt (i + 1)), IsIrreducible f
    • arrB (i : ℕ) : i < self.n → self.fwd i = false → ∃ (f : self.pt (i + 1) ⟶ self.pt i), IsIrreducible f
    • uniqF (i : ℕ) : i < self.n → ∀ (f g : self.pt i ⟶ self.pt (i + 1)), IsIrreducible f → IsIrreducible g → f = g
    • uniqB (i : ℕ) : i < self.n → ∀ (f g : self.pt (i + 1) ⟶ self.pt i), IsIrreducible f → IsIrreducible g → f = g
    • nz {X Y : RayVert (Cover x₀)} (p : Quiver.Path X Y) : PathIn {c : Cover x₀ | ∃ a ≤ self.n, self.pt a = c} p → pathVal p ≠ 0

      No relations: every path inside the line has nonzero value.
